_about: Every imported sheet, where it came from and its licence. tools/night.py bakes assets/src into the night-palette sheets in assets/night that the game loads; tools/validate.js checks this file against js/atlas.js and the files on disk. Grade: 'night' for scenery (dark, cold, neon-ready), 'mild' for characters, 'none' to leave as is.
